work-productivity-nano-pdf-workflow-helper 0.1.0

- Initial release providing practical workflow help for Nano Pdf-style productivity tasks on Clawhub.
- Supports bug fixing, setup hardening, reliability improvements, and adjacent workflow creation for agent users.
- Offers step-by-step guidance, reusable checklists, and artifact generation for work-productivity and pdf-related requirements.
- Ensures outputs are actionable, locally executable, and tailored to user needs.
- Triggered by keywords such as work-productivity, nano-pdf, pdf, edit, and related terms.
